units.title: Vectors and Space
units.blurb: Work with vectors, lines, planes and surfaces in three dimensions.

units.title: Vector-Valued Functions
units.blurb: Describe curves in space and the motion along them.

units.title: Partial Derivatives
units.blurb: Study functions of several variables: limits, partial derivatives, the chain rule and gradients.

units.title: Optimization
units.blurb: Find and classify extreme values, with and without constraints.

units.title: Multiple Integrals
units.blurb: Integrate over regions in the plane and in space, in any coordinates.

topics.title: Three-Dimensional Coordinates
topics.short: Locate points with (x, y, z) and find distances in space.
topics.trouble: Students sketch the axes so the right-hand rule fails, or drop the z term from the distance formula.

topics.title: Vectors in Three Dimensions
topics.short: Add, scale and find the length of 3D vectors.

topics.title: The Dot Product and Projections
topics.short: u · v = |u||v| cos θ, and the projection of one vector on another.
topics.trouble: Students mix up the scalar projection and the vector projection.

topics.title: The Cross Product
topics.short: u × v is perpendicular to both, with length equal to the parallelogram's area.
topics.trouble: Students assume u × v = v × u, or lose the minus sign on the middle component.

topics.title: Lines in Space
topics.short: r(t) = r₀ + tv.
topics.trouble: Students think two lines that do not meet must be parallel, missing skew lines.

topics.title: Planes
topics.short: A normal vector and a point give a(x − x₀) + b(y − y₀) + c(z − z₀) = 0.
topics.trouble: Students use a vector lying in the plane as the normal vector.

topics.title: Distances to Lines and Planes
topics.short: Project onto a normal to find the shortest distance.

topics.title: Cylinders and Quadric Surfaces
topics.short: Identify surfaces by their traces in the coordinate planes.

topics.title: Cylindrical and Spherical Coordinates
topics.short: Describe points by (r, θ, z) or (ρ, θ, φ).
topics.trouble: Students mix up θ and φ, or measure φ from the xy-plane instead of the positive z-axis.

topics.title: Vector-Valued Functions and Space Curves
topics.short: r(t) traces a curve as t changes.

topics.title: Derivatives and Integrals of Vector Functions
topics.short: Differentiate and integrate component by component.

topics.title: Curvature and the Unit Tangent and Normal
topics.short: Curvature measures how fast the direction turns.
topics.trouble: Students forget to divide by |r′(t)|, so the "unit" tangent is not unit length.

topics.title: Velocity and Acceleration in Space
topics.short: Split acceleration into tangential and normal parts.

topics.title: Functions of Several Variables
topics.short: Read surfaces and level curves of z = f(x, y).
topics.trouble: Students read level curves that are close together as a gentle slope.

topics.title: Functions of Three Variables and Level Surfaces
topics.short: f(x, y, z) = k describes a surface.

topics.title: Limits and Continuity
topics.short: A limit must agree along every path.
topics.trouble: Students check only straight-line paths and conclude a limit exists.

topics.title: Partial Derivatives
topics.short: Differentiate in one variable while holding the others fixed.
topics.trouble: Students differentiate the other variable too instead of treating it as a constant.

topics.title: Higher-Order Partials
topics.short: Mixed partials fxy and fyx agree for smooth functions.

topics.title: Tangent Planes and Linear Approximation
topics.short: z ≈ f(a, b) + fx(x − a) + fy(y − b).

topics.title: Differentials and Error Estimates
topics.short: Estimate how small errors in inputs affect the output.

topics.title: The Chain Rule for Several Variables
topics.short: Add up the effects through every path of dependence.
topics.trouble: Students leave out one of the paths from the output to the variable.

topics.title: Implicit Differentiation with Partials
topics.short: dy/dx = −Fx/Fy.
topics.trouble: Students forget the minus sign.

topics.title: Directional Derivatives
topics.short: The rate of change in the direction of a unit vector u.
topics.trouble: Students use a direction vector that is not unit length.

topics.title: The Gradient
topics.short: ∇f points uphill fastest, with length equal to the steepest rate.
topics.trouble: Students draw the gradient on the surface instead of in the domain.

topics.title: Gradients, Level Sets and Normal Lines
topics.short: ∇f is perpendicular to level curves and level surfaces.

topics.title: Local Extrema and the Second Derivative Test
topics.short: Use D = fxx·fyy − (fxy)² to classify critical points.
topics.trouble: Students forget that D < 0 means a saddle, or reach a conclusion when D = 0.

topics.title: Absolute Extrema on Closed Regions
topics.short: Check critical points inside and the whole boundary.
topics.trouble: Students skip the boundary or its corner points.

topics.title: Lagrange Multipliers
topics.short: At a constrained extreme, ∇f is parallel to ∇g.
topics.trouble: Students solve for λ but forget to check every solution of the system.

topics.title: Lagrange Multipliers with Two Constraints
topics.short: ∇f = λ∇g + μ∇h.

topics.title: Gradient Descent
topics.short: Step against the gradient, x ← x − η∇f, to walk downhill toward a low point.
topics.trouble: Students step along +∇f (uphill), or think a bigger step always gets there sooner, when a step that is too big overshoots and can blow up.

topics.title: Fitting a Model by Minimizing Loss
topics.short: Choose a line's slope and intercept to make the mean squared error as small as possible.
topics.trouble: Students differentiate with respect to x instead of the parameters m and b, or drop the minus sign the chain rule brings out of (y − (mx + b))².

topics.title: Backpropagation Is the Chain Rule
topics.short: Get every weight's derivative of a network's loss by working backward, one layer at a time.
topics.trouble: Students forget the ReLU switch on the way back (its derivative is 1 when the unit is on and 0 when it is off), or multiply by the weight itself instead of the input that the weight multiplies.

topics.title: Double Integrals over Rectangles
topics.short: Volume under a surface as a limit of sums.

topics.title: Iterated Integrals and Fubini's Theorem
topics.short: Integrate one variable at a time.

topics.title: Double Integrals over General Regions
topics.short: Let the inner limits depend on the outer variable.
topics.trouble: Students put variables in the outer limits of integration.

topics.title: Reversing the Order of Integration
topics.short: Redraw the region and describe it the other way.
topics.trouble: Students swap the limits without redrawing the region.

topics.title: Double Integrals in Polar Coordinates
topics.short: dA = r dr dθ.
topics.trouble: Students forget the extra factor r.

topics.title: Mass, Center of Mass and Probability
topics.short: Integrate density over a region.

topics.title: Surface Area of a Graph
topics.short: A = ∬√(1 + fx² + fy²) dA.

topics.title: Triple Integrals
topics.short: Integrate over solid regions.

topics.title: Triple Integrals in Cylindrical Coordinates
topics.short: dV = r dz dr dθ.

topics.title: Triple Integrals in Spherical Coordinates
topics.short: dV = ρ² sin φ dρ dφ dθ.
topics.trouble: Students forget the factor ρ² sin φ, or use the wrong range for φ.

topics.title: Mass and Moments of Solids
topics.short: Find mass, centers of mass and moments of inertia.

topics.title: Change of Variables and the Jacobian
topics.short: Transform a region and scale by |∂(x, y)/∂(u, v)|.
topics.trouble: Students drop the absolute value of the Jacobian, or use its reciprocal.
